text:
I give you my naked soul,

like a statue no fine veil shields.


Naked with the pure shamelessness

of a fruit, a star, or a flower;

of all those things that possess

the infinite serenity of Eve before the curse.


Of all those things—

fruits, stars, and roses—

unashamed of sex without a covering,

for whom no one would dare fashion clothes.


Unveiled, like the body of a serene goddess

with the intense whiteness of a lily!


Naked, thrown entirely open,

by the longing to love!

translation.title: I Give You My Naked Soul
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the prelapsarian body and the speaker's movement from exposure toward active desire.
